findings.description: Replay validation conflates transport ACCEPTANCE (HTTP 200) with the model HONORING reasoning as continuity; endpoint may accept and ignore an unknown field.
findings.resolution: AC6 rewritten to report acceptance (200/400) and honoring (turn-2 continuity) SEPARATELY with a named probe-decision.md artifact and explicit best-effort-plaintext-injection downgrade; matching Risk bullet added.

findings.description: Open/close sequencing of the new reasoning accumulator vs the existing AssistantMessageItem when both are driven from the same SSE chunk is underdefined.
findings.resolution: Architecture + Ordering risk + chat_transport Files line now require the accumulator to be threaded into BOTH handle_translated_events and handle_event, closing on first ContentDelta and ToolCallDelta and at finish.

findings.description: No bounded-history strategy for plaintext reasoning; history.rs:445-466 clones Reasoning unchanged and the fork forbids items >10K tokens.
findings.resolution: New HIGH Risk 'Bounded plaintext-reasoning history' + AC13 (cap/truncation regression test) + In-Scope bounded cap + Open-Q cap value.

findings.description: Tests miss the reasoning-then-tool-call path; AC3 only covers reasoning-then-content, but tool-only turns produce no assistant text.
findings.resolution: AC14 added (reasoning->tool-call ordering test asserting reasoning item closed before FunctionCall finalized); Ordering risk + Files line updated to close on ToolCallDelta.

findings.description: Attach-to-following-assistant-message replay is infeasible without buffering since push_chat_message is item-by-item (payload.rs:277, caller loop 257-261); plan did not specify the attach implementation.
findings.resolution: Risk 'attach-vs-standalone' now defaults to standalone (stateless) and names the buffering approach at payload.rs:257-261 for the attach case; US-003 description + Open-Q resolved.

findings.description: patch-surface.md ledger path ambiguous/wrong; external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/docs/implementation/patch-surface.md does not exist.
findings.resolution: Verified canonical ledger = codex/docs/implementation/patch-surface.md; fixed Files line, AC10, both decomposition shared paths, and the JSON sidecar; removed the stale Open Question.

findings.description: AC12 was code-review-only and ambiguous about the success condition (preserve/serialize/avoid-crash).
findings.resolution: AC12 rewritten as a concrete test: feed Reasoning{content:[ReasoningText], encrypted_content:Some("sig")} through build_chat_request_body/push_chat_message; assert no panic, plaintext replays, original item unmutated.

findings.description: AC5 (persist) and AC7 (replay) are tested separately but not the end-to-end path OutputItemDone(Reasoning)->history->build_responses_request->build_chat_request_body->push_chat_message.
findings.resolution: AC15 added (end-to-end integration test stitching persistence and replay).

findings.description: The 'reasoning variant cannot live on overlay ChatStreamEvent to avoid a Cargo cycle' justification is inaccurate; a neutral ReasoningDelta(String) could live there and be mapped in core.
findings.resolution: Architecture justification corrected: ReasoningDelta is core-owned to honor the core-only-capture constraint (keep overlay ChatStreamEvent untouched), not because of a hard Cargo-cycle limit.

findings.description: US-001 is a cross-repo dependency of US-003 but Next Step launches one job; autonomous executor needs a concrete order.
findings.resolution: Lead Note now gives the concrete order (probe first -> write probe-decision.md -> codex impl) and notes US-002 parallelizes with US-001.

findings.description: Replay needs an explicit message-vs-field-shape decision; AC7 assumed the decided shape is already known.
findings.resolution: AC6 decision record + AC7 reworded ('or inline-plaintext fallback') + Risk field-shape bullet make the shape an explicit US-001 output consumed by US-003.
